# TRENIKO — https://treniko.com/
#
# `/` is a public landing page and is meant to be indexed. Everything else in
# this app is either an authentication screen or sits behind a login, so it is
# disallowed here as well as being marked `noindex, nofollow` at runtime by
# src/seo/RouteMeta.jsx. Two layers, because a crawler that does not execute
# JavaScript never sees the runtime tag.
#
# Add a private route? Add it in both places.

User-agent: *
Allow: /$
Allow: /privacy
Allow: /terms

# Static content pages. Not part of the SPA — generated by
# scripts/generate-content-pages.mjs and served straight off disk, so their text
# is in the response body rather than behind a JavaScript render.
Allow: /personal-trainer-software
Allow: /personal-trainer-client-management-software
Allow: /guides
Allow: /free-personal-trainer-client-tracker
Allow: /personal-trainer-pricing-calculator
Allow: /downloads/
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /register
Disallow: /forgot-password
Disallow: /reset-password
Disallow: /verify-email
Disallow: /check-email
Disallow: /dashboard
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /uploads/

# ── AI crawlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Today these directives change nothing: Cloudflare blocks every AI agent at the
# edge, so none of them ever reaches this file. They are here so that the day
# that setting is changed, the right policy is already in place rather than the
# site going from "everything blocked" to "everything allowed" in one click.
#
# The distinction that matters, and which the blanket edge block does not make:
#
#   * TRAINING crawlers collect pages to train a model. Disallowed below. Nothing
#     about being discoverable depends on them.
#
#   * USER-INITIATED agents fetch a page because a person asked an assistant to
#     open it. ChatGPT-User, Claude-User and OAI-SearchBot are these. They get
#     NO group of their own on purpose — a group containing only `Allow: /`
#     would override the `User-agent: *` rules above and hand them /dashboard,
#     /admin and /api as well. Falling through to `*` is what gives them the
#     public pages and nothing else, which is exactly right.
#
# Google-Extended governs Gemini training only. It does NOT affect Googlebot,
# indexing or Search ranking — those are a different token and are untouched.

User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

Sitemap: https://treniko.com/sitemap.xml
